title: METR and Redwood red-team finds ways OpenAI agents could evade internal monitoring
summary: METR and Redwood Research ran a three-week assessment with access to OpenAI's internal infrastructure. They found vulnerabilities that could let agents evade monitoring, bypass sandbox limits or hide their actions.
reason: An independent audit confirms gaps in agent oversight; the external access is a positive sign, so the net effect is a small F3 decrease.

title: OpenAI nears up to $30B round at ~$1.25T valuation led by UAE investors, CNBC says
summary: CNBC reports OpenAI is closing a round of up to $30B that values it at about $1.25T, led by UAE investors, and aims to sign by the end of next week. The size is not final.
reason: Detailed reporting by a major outlet on capital concentrating in one lab; not yet closed, so a T1 signal.

title: SK Hyper seeks $350B to build 15 GW of AI data centers in South Korea by 2035
summary: SK Hyper's CEO said the first 5 GW phase needs $350B, toward 15 GW of AI data centers by 2035, and the company is raising an outside round.
reason: A large compute plan, still a fundraising proposal, so T1 signal.
